open-queue-keybind.name: Open Queue
open-queue-keybind.description: Opens the queue visualizer from anywhere.

queue-update-notifications.name: Show Queue Update Notifcations
queue-update-notifications.description: Show updates on queue progress regularly. May be a little repetitve if you don't care about them.

comment-delete-timeout.name: Comment Delete Delay
comment-delete-timeout.description: The delay (seconds) between deleting comments. The minimum is technically ~1.667⅔ requests per second (or ~0.667 seconds between each item), but for safety this is rounded up to 1 second.

queue-item-timeout.name: Queue Process Delay
queue-item-timeout.description: The delay (seconds) between processing each level in queue. This option is not very necessary, but you can use it if needed.

queue-timeout.name: Queue Schedule Delay
queue-timeout.description: The delay (seconds) between rescheduling the queue. Useful for levels with disabled comments.
